hero_headline: Sustainable Living Built with Earth & Precision
hero_subtext: Vedant Bhomi Venture (also known as Vedaanth ECO Buildcon / VEBCO) crafts vernacular, climate-responsive homes and commercial buildings using CSEB mud bricks and mortar-free interlocking brick technology across Bangalore, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh.
about_story: Vedant Bhomi Venture (also known as Vedaanth ECO Buildcon / VEBCO) is a premier construction company working on vernacular architecture and innovative sustainable technology using CSEB (Compressed Stabilized Earth Blocks) and Interlocking bricks across Bangalore, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh. Interlocking bricks lock into each other, giving the wall exceptional structural strength without cement mortar bonding. Saves about 60% of cement and sand, water usage is drastically reduced, and work is completed in fast-track mode with our head office at Jigani, Karnataka.
